tail:
VERDICT: CLEAN
BOUNDARY: The explicit extension F(x) = (max{0, min{1,x}})^2 was inspected for all real x. At the interval endpoints 0 and 1 the formula correctly recovers f(0)=0 and f(1)=1; the left and right limits of F match the function values, so F is continuous on ℝ. The generalisation in the first remark (clamp composition for any closed bounded interval [a,b]) also holds: the clamp is continuous, reduces to the identity on [a,b], and composition with a continuous f yields a continuous extension; the degenerate case a=b gives a constant clamp and a valid constant extension. No boundary or degenerate case breaks the claim.
